LESSON: MY EXTENDED FAMILY

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: QUR’AN
Topic 1.1: My extended family

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about My extended family. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise the alphabet (fat'ha, kasra, dhumm
2. name correctly three • Learners are guided to use digital (

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognise the alphabet (fat'ha, kasra, dhumm
   In simple words: practise until you can recognise the alphabet (fat'ha, kasra, dhumm. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. name correctly three • Learners are guided to use digital (
   In simple words: practise until you can name correctly three • Learners are guided to use digital (. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about My extended family using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about My extended family in the examples.
2. Explain My extended family to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand My extended family.
4. Show that you can: recognise the alphabet (fat'ha, kasra, dhumm

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My extended family using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is My extended family important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners listen to and sing songs d) write the Arabic alphabet on Arabic alphabet with vowels. from right to left adding
2. Learners practice pronouncing the vowels on them Arabic alphabet with vowels in pairs or small groups.
3. Identify Arabic alphabet with vowels through digital literacy and games.
4. Be shown displayed Arabic alphabet with vowels to read.
5. Learners practice the correct orientation of reading and writing the Arabic alphabet with vowels (right to left)

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise the alphabet (fat'ha, kasra, dhumm
2. name correctly three • Learners are guided to use digital (
